prop:source-bound.title: Scaled source control of physical stationarity
prop:source-bound.note: Proved. The positive source space with Gram G_h is a real inner-product space W (its norm is the G_h norm); the finite action covector a_h is a continuous linear functional a : W ->L[R] R whose operator norm is the dual norm ||a_h||_{G_h^{-1}} (source_bound), equivalently the G_h-norm of its Riesz representative alpha (source_bound_riesz, using innerSL_apply_norm). The test space V is any real normed space (the C^{r_0} norm), v_h : V -> W the source lift, and Phi v = D S_h(z_h^d)[I_h v]. stationarityDefect Phi := iSup over the unit ball of |Phi v| encodes eps_h(K) of eq:stationarity. From ||a||^2 <= R_h, ||v_h(v)|| <= L_h ||v|| and |Phi v - a(v_h v)| <= e_h ||v||, source_bound_pointwise gives |Phi v| <= (L_h sqrt R_h + e_h)||v|| (Cauchy-Schwarz = ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm, sqrt monotonicity, triangle inequality) and source_bound gives eps_h(K) <= L_h sqrt R_h + e_h (ciSup_le over the nonempty unit ball). The 'in particular' clause is source_bound_tendsto: along a regulator sequence, L_h sqrt R_h + e_h -> 0 forces eps_h(K) -> 0 (squeeze_zero with stationarityDefect_nonneg_of_bound). Scoped hypotheses disclosed: the constants L_h, e_h are taken nonnegative (needed only to pass from the ||v||-scaled bound to the unit-ball supremum); the lift v_h need not be linear; the earlier pointer gt_protected_riesz was not needed.

Needs reformulation: either weaken (I1)/(I4) to abstract fields (then it becomes a medium assembly) or build the missing carrier, which is research-level.

lem:SM-descent.title: Descent and covariant Yukawa blocks
lem:SM-descent.note: Partial: the target group G_SM of eq:gauge-group is realised as S(U(3) x U(2)) with the explicit presentation (SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1)) / Z_6 (smGaugeQuotientEquiv, kernel identified as the central sixth roots of unity in mem_smGaugeHom_ker_iff_centralZ6), and the Higgs doublet with its weak U(2) action is a representation of G_SM itself (higgsRep), so its descent is by construction ; missing: the fermion representations of tab:SM-representations with their hypercharges and the verification that the central Z_6 acts trivially on each (the descent clause proper), the explicit Yukawa blocks eq:explicit-Yukawa-blocks with the conjugate doublet i sigma_2 conj(H), the neutral/Majorana extension, affinity of M_Y(H) in real Higgs coordinates and the bound eq:yukawa-bound on bounded coefficient banks.
lem:SM-descent.plan: Build on StandardModel/SMGaugeQuotientExact.lean and StandardModel/FiniteEinsteinStandardModelInterface.lean: define the one-generation table representations on the cover SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1) with the hypercharge phases, prove the Z_6 kernel acts trivially (a finite root-of-unity computation per row, e.g. exp(2 pi i (n/3 - m/2 + Y)) = 1 for the table's Y), hence descent through smGaugeQuotientEquiv; define M_Y(H) as the block bilinear map with Y_u, Y_d, Y_e in M_3(C), prove affinity in Re/Im H and the operator-norm bound eq:yukawa-bound by the triangle inequality. Days of finite representation algebra.

lem:Whitney.title: Commuting reconstruction and positive comparison norm
lem:Whitney.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: Whitney form, de Rham map, commuting coboundary, mass matrix, projection convergence; only the Loomis-Whitney inequality (Grand/AtlasIsoperimetry.lean) exists, which is unrelated.
lem:Whitney.plan: Whitney forms on a shape-regular simplicial mesh, the de Rham map, R_h W_h = I and d W_h = W_h d_h need simplicial complexes with barycentric coordinates and differential forms on simplices; Mathlib has neither simplicial differential forms nor Stokes on simplices, and the library's only Whitney hit is the Loomis-Whitney inequality. The mass-matrix positivity and strong convergence of projections also need L^2 forms. Hard infrastructure.

prop:mesh-consistency.title: Smooth local action consistency
prop:mesh-consistency.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: parallel transport Taylor expansion, plaquette holonomy I + h^2 F + O(h^3), Riemann-sum quadrature error, differentiated transport.
prop:mesh-consistency.plan: Requires parallel-transport ODE Taylor expansions U_mu = I + h A + O(h^2), the four-edge plaquette product (partially: DiscreteAnalysis/CovariantPlaquetteExpansion.lean gives the unshifted exponential plaquette), covariant Taylor expansions for Higgs and spinor differences, the mollified interpolant estimates eq:smooth-reconstruction-estimate, and Riemann-sum quadrature error O(h) for smooth densities on a 4D region. Continuum fields, transport ODEs and quadrature on regions are all missing. Hard.

lem:native-discrete-KR.title: Discrete translation compactness
lem:native-discrete-KR.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: discrete translation compactness, Kolmogorov-Riesz, Frechet-Kolmogorov, uniform L^2 translation modulus, piecewise-constant reconstruction R_h^0. Mathlib has no Kolmogorov-Riesz (Frechet-Kolmogorov) compactness theorem in L^2.
lem:native-discrete-KR.plan: Requires the Kolmogorov-Riesz theorem for L^2 on a bounded 4D region (uniform boundedness + uniform translation modulus implies precompactness), transported to piecewise-constant reconstructions of grid functions (the translation modulus of R_h^0 u_h at scale rho is controlled by the discrete moduli at |m| h <= rho plus an O(h) term). Mathlib lacks Kolmogorov-Riesz; the closest library tools are Arzela-Ascoli based (Continuum/UniformLipschitzSubsequenceCompactnessExact.lean, Continuum/ThreadCutoffCompactnessExact.lean), which would need a mollification argument. Hard (infrastructure).

lem:native-critical-grid.title: Critical grid bounds and link coefficients
lem:native-critical-grid.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: discrete Sobolev L^4 bound on the 4D periodic grid, unitary internal graph norm, discrete H^1 compactness, trigonometric reconstruction, link coefficient convergence h||A||_inf -> 0. DiscreteAnalysis/OperationalSobolevWeylExact.lean has finite 3D coarea/L^6 Sobolev bounds on weighted graphs, not the 4D critical grid inequality, and no reconstruction operators exist.
lem:native-critical-grid.plan: The critical 4D discrete Sobolev inequality eq:native-grid-Sobolev-a (via discrete Gagliardo-Nirenberg or Fourier on DiscreteAnalysis/LatticeTorusPlancherel.lean) is a medium finite lemma; the covariant version, the discrete Rellich compactness with weak convergence of forward differences, the H^1 compactness of trigonometric reconstructions and the L^4 link-coefficient convergence need continuum Sobolev spaces and reconstruction operators absent from Mathlib. Hard.

lem:native-reconstruction-identification.title: Identification of raw and trigonometric first jets
lem:native-reconstruction-identification.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: trigonometric interpolation I_h^trig, piecewise-constant reconstruction, discrete H^1 norm, identification of first jets, odd periodic grids. Needs multidimensional Fourier series on the torus and their L^2/H^1 norms.
lem:native-reconstruction-identification.plan: Needs the 4D trigonometric interpolant on odd grids of side 2 pi and its Fourier representation (Mathlib has Fourier series only on AddCircle in one dimension; DiscreteAnalysis/LatticeTorusPlancherel.lean gives the discrete Plancherel identity on (Z/nZ)^d, which supplies the discrete side), the comparison ||I^trig u - R^0 u||_2 <= C h ||D^+ u||_{2,h}, the H^1 bound via symbols, and the identification of strong L^2 limits of R^0 D^+ u with weak derivatives (distributional calculus absent). Hard.

prop:native-Higgs-compactness.title: Native Higgs graph compactness
prop:native-Higgs-compactness.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: native Higgs graph compactness, literal Higgs-link packet, covariant gradient packet, quartic Higgs endpoint.
prop:native-Higgs-compactness.plan: Composition of lem:native-critical-grid (discrete H^1 compactness and L^4 strong convergence) with the link-coefficient convergence and the identification K = D_A H by weak-strong products (Continuum/WeakStrongBilinearPairingExact.lean). prop:native-YM-identification.title: Identification and variation of the literal curvature
prop:native-YM-identification.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: literal curvature identification F = F_A, discrete curvature limit, Yang-Mills first variation convergence, gauge test lift S_h a. Needs distributional identification of the limit of discrete plaquette curvatures with dA + A wedge A in L^2.
prop:native-YM-identification.plan: Requires the plaquette expansion of lem:native-plaquette (proved: DiscreteAnalysis/ShiftedPlaquetteLogarithmUniformExact.lean) passed to the limit in distributions: weak derivatives of the L^4 limit A, the product A wedge A in L^2 (Holder), and the strong L^2 convergence of the discrete first variation D_A F_h[S_h a] (finite-difference consistency on smooth tests, DiscreteAnalysis/UniformFiniteDifferenceRemainderExact.lean). Distributional calculus and Sobolev spaces on a chart are absent from Mathlib. Hard.

prop:native-spinor-variation.title: Weak native spinor graphs and the complete Dirac variation
prop:native-spinor-variation.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: weak native spinor graphs, complete Dirac variation, coframe-derived spin connection, spin-link margin.

Mathlib has no Sobolev spaces on charts/tori, no Rellich compactness and no continuum gauge/spinor bundles; nothing in the library encodes these objects.

prop:native-gravity-firstjet.title: Literal gravitational consistency from strong first jets
prop:native-gravity-firstjet.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: gravitational consistency from strong first jets, native gravity first variation, symmetric metric lift, log margin. Continuum limit of the finite Palatini/Cartan first variation under strong L^2 first-jet convergence of nodal coframes in a compact chart.
prop:native-gravity-firstjet.plan: Needs the first-jet normal form of the local gravitational density (proved: Action/NativeFirstJetNormalFormExact.lean, gravityDensity_eq_curl, localAction_eq_action_firstJetDensity) composed with the continuum Palatini first variation on L^2-convergent first jets (bounded-coefficient products, Gravity/WeakPalatiniPassageExact.lean pattern) and the finite-difference consistency of the lifted inverse-metric tests. The passage from grid sums to integrals with L^2-convergent reconstructions requires Sobolev/L^p field spaces on a chart, absent from Mathlib. Hard.

thm:native-firstvariation-no-band.title: All-sector native consistency without a growing band
thm:native-firstvariation-no-band.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: all-sector native consistency, growing band, literal logarithmic curvature, unit test family, distributional Euler equations.
thm:native-firstvariation-no-band.plan: Assembly of prop:native-Higgs-compactness, prop:native-spinor-variation, the gravity first-jet consistency and the Yang-Mills sector limit into eq:native-all-sector-limit, then thm:abstract-closure (easy) for the Euler equations. All sector limits need the continuum Sobolev/reconstruction infrastructure absent from Mathlib. Hard.

thm:native-Wilson-compactness.title: Direct native Wilson compactness
thm:native-Wilson-compactness.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: Wilson compactness, covariant translation modulus Omega_h, precompact magnitude |R_h^0 Y_h|, uniform integrability of the square, unitary internal representation. Discrete Kolmogorov-Riesz for the magnitude plus lem:translation-Kato and lem:compact-magnitude-ui.
thm:native-Wilson-compactness.plan: Composition of lem:translation-Kato (easy), lem:native-discrete-KR (hard: Kolmogorov-Riesz absent from Mathlib), lem:compact-magnitude-ui (medium: finite epsilon-net argument, MeasureTheory.UnifIntegrable) and, for the vector statement, the covariant-to-ordinary translation comparison under a discrete L^2 connection bound. The Kolmogorov-Riesz step is the blocker. Hard.

lem:native-discrete-Hodge.title: Exact periodic discrete Hodge identity
lem:native-discrete-Hodge.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: discrete Hodge identity, periodic forward differences, discrete exterior derivative d_h^+, discrete codifferential delta_h, discrete H^1 norm. The periodic grid, forward/backward differences and summation by parts exist (Action/NativeFirstJetNormalFormExact.lean: NativeDensity.sum_mul_fwdDiff; Action/ShiftedFirstJetNormalFormExact.lean: ShiftedFirstJet.bwdDiff, sum_bwdDiff) but the identity is not stated.
lem:native-discrete-Hodge.plan: New file DiscreteAnalysis/PeriodicDiscreteHodgeIdentityExact.lean on the periodic grid Grid n of Action/ShiftedJetActionHessianExact.lean: define d_h^+ A (mu nu) = D^+_mu A_nu - D^+_nu A_mu and delta_h A = - sum_mu D^-_mu A_mu, expand ||d^+ A||^2 = 2 sum_{mu,nu} ||D_mu A_nu||^2 - 2 sum_{mu,nu} <D_mu A_nu, D_nu A_mu>, and show sum_{mu,nu} <D^+_mu A_nu, D^+_nu A_mu> = sum_{mu,nu} <D^-_mu A_mu, D^-_nu A_nu> = ||delta A||^2 by two summations by parts (NativeDensity.sum_mul_fwdDiff / ShiftedFirstJet.sum_bwdDiff) and commutation of shifts; the H^1 bound is then the triangle inequality. Finite algebra, <= 1 day.

thm:native-discrete-Coulomb.title: Critical discrete Coulomb compactness
thm:native-discrete-Coulomb.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: discrete Coulomb gauge, delta_h A_h = 0, small L^4 Coulomb ball, strong L^4 / H^1 precompactness of discrete connections, F = F_A identification. Purely discrete but requires uniform-in-h discrete Sobolev/Hodge estimates on the periodic 4D grid.
thm:native-discrete-Coulomb.plan: Needs the exact periodic discrete Hodge identity lem:native-discrete-Hodge (medium: summation by parts on (Z/nZ)^4, DiscreteAnalysis/LatticeTorusPlancherel.lean supplies the transform), the uniform discrete Sobolev inequality ||u||_{4,h} <= C ||D^+ u||_{2,h} on mean-zero 4D grid functions (absent; DiscreteAnalysis/OperationalSobolevWeylExact.lean is 3D isoperimetric), the small-ball absorption of the quadratic term, and the strong-limit identification of lem:native-reconstruction-identification / prop:native-YM-identification. Hard.

lem:native-log-gauge-differential.title: Exact logarithmic site-gauge differential
lem:native-log-gauge-differential.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: logarithmic site gauge, gauge differential, ad_A, dexp inverse series K(Z), site-gauge energy differential, delta_h A. Algebra/SeriesLogUnitConjugation.lean only proves conjugation equivariance of the series logarithm, not its derivative along a gauge curve.
lem:native-log-gauge-differential.plan: Needs the Frechet derivative of the matrix logarithm chart at a non-identity point along the curve t -> e^{t xi_x} e^{h A_mu} e^{-t xi_{x+e_mu}}, i.e. the inverse of d exp (the series K(Z) = Z/(1 - e^{-Z}) type multiplier applied to ad_{A_mu}) and the averaging operator m_mu. Mathlib has the exponential series and its derivative only at commuting arguments; the derivative of log in a normed algebra (Algebra/SeriesLogUnitConjugation.lean, DiscreteAnalysis/ShiftedPlaquetteLogarithmExact.lean provide the series and analyticity) plus the dexp inverse identity is new infrastructure. The energy identity eq:native-gauge-energy-differential then follows by summation by parts. Hard.

lem:native-FP-inverse.title: Uniform transverse inverse
lem:native-FP-inverse.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: transverse inverse, Faddeev-Popov operator, coercivity on divergence-free grid functions, dual inverse bound, smooth dependence of the inverse. Coercivity of M_A on Z_h for small ||A||_{4,h} needs the uniform discrete Sobolev inequality; invertibility from coercivity is finite-dimensional.
lem:native-FP-inverse.plan: The finite-dimensional steps (coercivity implies invertibility on Z_h, the dual bound ||D^+ M_A^{-1} f||_{2,h} <= 2 ||f||_{H^{-1}_h}, smooth dependence on A via the inverse of a continuous family of invertible linear maps) are easy-to-medium on an abstract finite inner-product space (pattern: Gravity/SupplementExactTransverseElimination.lean). The coercivity eq:native-FP-coercivity itself needs |<[A,xi], D xi>| <= C ||A||_{4,h} ||D^+ xi||_{2,h}^2, i.e. the uniform 4D discrete Sobolev inequality ||xi||_{4,h} <= C ||D^+ xi||_{2,h} on mean-zero grid functions, absent from Mathlib and the library. Hard.

thm:finite-Coulomb-normalization.title: Finite critical Coulomb normalization
thm:finite-Coulomb-normalization.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: finite Coulomb normalization, logarithmic seed, finite site gauge, delta_h A = 0, critical seed threshold.
thm:finite-Coulomb-normalization.plan: Finite-dimensional Coulomb gauge fixing by a continuity/implicit-function argument on the periodic grid using lem:native-log-gauge-differential (hard), the discrete Hodge identity (easy) and a discrete critical Sobolev inequality (medium). prop:rooted-gauge-certificate.title: Rooted same-record gauge certificate
prop:rooted-gauge-certificate.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: rooted spanning tree gauge, tree gauge, Wilson seed B^T_h, site-gauge invariance of the certificate, invariance of the finite action sectors and of the covector norm. The clause that the tree gauge followed by thm:finite-Coulomb-normalization yields exact small discrete Coulomb gauge inherits the hard uniform discrete Sobolev / FP-inverse machinery of lem:native-FP-inverse. lem:determinant-screen-flux.title: Determinant compactness, admissibility, and flux
lem:determinant-screen-flux.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: determinant screen, adjoint Wilson modulus, coordinate-plane flux, integer flux 2 pi m, translation modulus. The flux-integer clause (the sum of log-phases over a periodic coordinate 2-torus is 2 pi times an integer because the product of the plaquette holonomies telescopes to 1) is finite algebra with no library counterpart; AffinityCohomology.lean handles real (additive) cycle affinities on graphs, not U(1) phases modulo 2 pi.

Hard overall.

lem:determinant-Hodge-stability.title: Strong stability of the periodic discrete Hodge inverse
lem:determinant-Hodge-stability.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: discrete Hodge inverse, delta_h Delta_h^dagger, closed zero-mean two-form, ||D^+ a||_{2,h} = ||f||_{2,h}, strong L^4 stability of the primitive. The finite identities are DFT computations; the L^4 bound and the strong reconstruction limits need discrete Sobolev and trigonometric interpolation.

The bounds L^{-1}||a^0||_{2,h} + ||a^0||_{4,h} <= C ||f||_{2,h} need the uniform 4D discrete Poincare/Sobolev inequalities (absent), and the strong L^4 / L^2 / H^1 convergence of reconstructions needs lem:native-reconstruction-identification (hard). Hard.

prop:periodic-determinant-normalization.title: Zero-flux Abelian normalization with unrestricted flat holonomy
prop:periodic-determinant-normalization.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: Abelian normalization, Hodge primitive, flat residual holonomy, periodic site gauge, cycle holonomies.

Hard.

prop:native-determinant-split.title: Exact determinant normalization and semisimple remainder
prop:native-determinant-split.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: determinant normalization, semisimple remainder, central generator Z_c = (-i/3 I_3, i/2 I_2), site lift t_h, Pi_ss projection of the curvature, adjoint Wilson transport. Finite lattice-gauge algebra in S(U(3) x U(2)) with a central U(1) factor.

Build on GaugeTheory/LatticeHolonomyGaugeCovariance.lean for the gauge action on links.

lem:flat-semisimple-normalization.title: Flat semisimple normalization without a small-holonomy assumption
lem:flat-semisimple-normalization.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: flat link field, constant links, commuting logarithms, SU(3) x SU(2), cycle holonomies. GaugeTheory/LatticeHolonomyGaugeCovariance.lean has walks, holonomy and gauge transforms but no flatness or normal form.
lem:flat-semisimple-normalization.plan: Two steps: (1) a flat periodic link field on ZMod grids is gauge equivalent to constant links given by the four commuting cycle holonomies (tree gauge on the periodic grid; finite group algebra, medium, build on GaugeTheory/LatticeHolonomyGaugeCovariance.lean); (2) commuting elements of SU(3) x SU(2) lie in a common maximal torus and admit commuting, uniformly bounded logarithms b with e^{h b} = link (simultaneous diagonalisation of a commuting family of unitaries and a bounded branch of log), for which Mathlib has no simultaneous spectral theorem. Hard.

cor:determinant-resolved-closure.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: determinant-resolved Wilson closure, semisimple-only certificate, co-closed logarithmic connection A_h = b_h + Z_c a_h, exact flatness alternative. A variant of thm:finite-Wilson-zero-defect with the determinant sector normalised separately.

lem:covariant-quadrature.title: Covariant cell-average quadrature
lem:covariant-quadrature.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: covariant cell average, parallel transport quadrature, Riemann-sum error with covariant derivative, unitary frame equivariance. An abstract version with transport maps as data (isometries with a first-order consistency bound) would be medium but changes the statement.

prop:equivariant-native-budgets.title: Equivariant native first-variation budgets
prop:equivariant-native-budgets.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: equivariant native budgets, covariant cell-average test lift I_h^cov, consistency c_h^eq <= C h B^3, stationarity eps_h^eq <= C sigma_h^link, link-row norm gauge invariance. Continuum consistency of the unchanged local action against covariant test lifts under the growing-band hypothesis.

prop:Wilson-packet-transfer.title: Finite packet and open-link transfer
prop:Wilson-packet-transfer.note: Partial: the frozen-coefficient core of eq:Wilson-packet-consistency (the four-link plaquette of constant links e^{hA}, e^{hB} differs from 1 + h^2[A,B] by an explicit cubic group-commutator error plus the exponential Taylor tail, so the logarithmic plaquette curvature is [A,B] + O(h B_h^2) for bounded generators) is norm_plaquette_sub_secondOrder_le ; missing: the x-dependent links of the reconstructed connection (the derivative terms of F_{A_h}), the Higgs-link packet estimate, the transport consistency eq:Wilson-transport-consistency for m-step links versus continuum parallel transport, and the modulus transfer eq:Wilson-finite-screen => eq:Wilson-continuum-screen.
prop:Wilson-packet-transfer.plan: Extend DiscreteAnalysis/CovariantPlaquetteExpansion.lean and DiscreteAnalysis/ShiftedPlaquetteLogarithmExact.lean to x-dependent links (Taylor expansion of the reconstructed connection across the cell) for eq:Wilson-packet-consistency (medium); the transport consistency needs continuum parallel transport (absent from Mathlib) and the modulus transfer needs L^2 translation moduli of reconstructed packets. Hard overall.

lem:translation-Kato.title: Translation Kato inequality
lem:translation-Kato.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: Kato inequality, translation modulus, reverse triangle inequality with unitary transport. The statement is | ||Y(x+s e_mu)|| - ||Y(x)|| | <= ||T^A Y(x) - Y(x)|| for a norm-preserving covariant translation T^A (parallel transport is a fibre isometry), i.e. abs_norm_sub_norm_le after ||T^A Y(x)|| = ||Y(x+s e_mu)||.

New file in DiscreteAnalysis/ or GaugeTheory/ next to GaugeTheory/LatticeHolonomyGaugeCovariance.lean (which supplies the link-transport conventions).

lem:compact-magnitude-ui.title: Compact scalar magnitude implies energy uniform integrability
lem:compact-magnitude-ui.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: relatively compact in L^2 implies uniform integrability, TotallyBounded with UnifIntegrable, epsilon-net uniform integrability. Mathlib has UnifIntegrable for finite families (unifIntegrable_finite) and for L^p-convergent sequences but not for totally bounded families; the library uses UnifIntegrable only in Continuum/GaussianKernelVitaliExact.lean (domination transfer).
lem:compact-magnitude-ui.plan: New file Continuum/CompactFamilyUniformIntegrabilityExact.lean: for a finite measure mu and a family f : iota -> Lp E 2 mu with TotallyBounded (range f), prove UnifIntegrable f 2 mu (which is eq:compact-magnitude-ui: sup over small sets of the L^2 norm of the indicator, i.e. of int_E |f|^2) by choosing a finite epsilon-net, applying MeasureTheory.unifIntegrable_finite to the net and the triangle inequality eLpNorm (indicator (f i)) <= eLpNorm (indicator (f i - g)) + eLpNorm (indicator g) <= epsilon + epsilon. <= 1 day.

prop:Wilson-screen-compactness.title: Covariant screen compactness at the critical endpoint
prop:Wilson-screen-compactness.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: covariant screen compactness, Wilson continuum screen, relatively compact magnitude in L^2_loc, uniform integrability, L^4 connection bound. Continuum Kolmogorov-Riesz compactness for |Y_h| plus a covariant-to-ordinary translation comparison.
prop:Wilson-screen-compactness.plan: Requires the Kolmogorov-Riesz (Frechet-Kolmogorov) theorem in L^2_loc (absent from Mathlib), lem:translation-Kato (easy), lem:compact-magnitude-ui (medium: finite epsilon-net + MeasureTheory.UnifIntegrable), and for the vector clause the estimate of the difference between covariant and ordinary translations by ||A_h||_{L^4} (Holder plus the transport expansion). lem:native-plaquette.note: Proved in a real Banach algebra 𝔄 with ‖1‖ = 1 (NormOneClass; scoped hypothesis, as in the previous partial), for X, Y, a, b in 𝔄. Bundled statement exists_joint_analytic_extension: there is Φ : ℝ × 𝔄⁴ → 𝔄 (jointLogPlaquette) with (i) Φ analytic at every (0, X, Y, a, b), (ii) Φ(0; X,Y,a,b) = a - b + [X,Y], (iii) h² Φ(h) = log(e^{hX} e^{h(Y+ha)} e^{-h(X+hb)} e^{-hY}) for all h ≠ 0 with the series logarithm log(1+z) = z Σ (-1)^n z^n/(n+1), and (iv) for every order k and every compact set K of parameters there are h₀ > 0 and C with ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Φ (h, q)‖ ≤ C for |h| ≤ h₀ and q ∈ K, i.e. all fixed-order derivatives in h and in the parameters are uniformly bounded on compact argument sets for small h (second sentence of the lemma). The 'analytic branch' is identified: exp(log(1+z)) = 1 + z for ‖z‖ < 1 (exp_logOneAdd, proved by differentiating t ↦ exp(-log(1+tz))(1+tz) with a Commute-based derivative of exp, no commutativity of 𝔄 needed), hence exp(h² Φ(h)) = P(h) whenever ‖P(h) - 1‖ < 1 (exp_sq_smul_logPlaquette). Method for (i)/(iv): exp u = 1 + u + u² E(u) with E entire (exp_eq_expRemainder), giving the explicit removable quotient P(h) - 1 = h² Q(h; X,Y,a,b) with Q a polynomial in h, X, Y, a, b and the E(h v_i) (product_sub_one_eq), equal to the dslope quotient of the previous partial for every h (quotient_eq_quotientPoly); Φ = Q · L(h² Q) is then jointly analytic on the open set ‖h² Q‖ < 1 ⊇ {0} × 𝔄⁴, and the bound (iv) follows by continuity of iteratedFDeriv on a compact tube [-h₀, h₀] × K (generalized tube lemma). Not restated separately: the one-variable h-derivatives are directional derivatives of the joint Fréchet derivatives, so they are covered by (iv).
